column1: # ACCEPTANCE_MANIFEST.tsv — the standing legs of the rebuild program.
# MAINTAINER RULING 2026-10-15: "We had a whole system in place to ensure no
# drift, and to ensure the trace contents were matching external sources.
# Dropping those should never have been an option. No justification for
# doing so should have been sufficient."
# RULES OF THIS FILE:
#  - Rows are added or removed ONLY by the maintainer. The orchestrator and
#    agents may never skip, waive, or adjudicate a row away — not under an
#    overnight grant, not for any reason. A wave that cannot run a row
#    STOPS and reports; it does not proceed without it.
#  - acceptance_gate.sh FAILS CLOSED: a row with no artifact, a stale
#    artifact (tip-sha stamp mismatch), or an artifact without its PASS
#    line is a FAIL. Absence is failure, never a pass.
#  - Every oracle/comparator a row relies on must have a fresh FIRING
#    PROOF (planted red) recorded in its artifact — a checker that cannot
#    fire proves nothing (references-always-enforced doctrine).
# Columns: leg_id <TAB> artifact_glob (under results dir) <TAB> required_line_regex <TAB> description
WIRE-PARITY
column4: Old-vs-rebuild wire comparison, same cells+seeds, both arms; every delta attributed to a maintainer-adjudicated bug in the original; stamped with BOTH tree tips. The original's output is the format spec, incl. template minting (feedback_wire_parity_is_spec).

column1: R13-EXTERNAL
column4: External-truth legs at the tip: referee (cst_referee) UNEXPLAINED=0 x4 ISAs + the applicable depmap/fdcheck/PIN legs, each with its firing proof (feedback_external_truth_standing_gate, feedback_references_always_enforced).

column1: DETERMINISM
column4: Per-cell r1-vs-r2 byte identity on decompressed segments, both arms, every matrix cell; a run with rc!=0 or a missing segment is NO-SUBJECT = FAIL.

column1: GOLDEN
column4: Golden-trace net at the tip (fixed golden .cst, never re-traced), or the maintainer-approved re-baseline record for an adjudicated wire change.

column1: BOUNDARY
column4: boundary_gate.sh: allowlist + engine line ratchet + boundary grep, fail=0, stamped at tip.

column1: SIMILARITY
column4: plugin_similarity_gate vs the frozen reference, with its planted-red proof.

column1: BUDGET
column4: PLUGIN_BUDGET / RATCHET_BASELINE deltas enumerated and adjudicated (maintainer sign-off recorded for any raise).

column1: RATE
column4: The ruled rate bar (20M insns in a few minutes or less; run and close reported separately) vs the ORIGINAL tracer's measured rate on the same cells (feedback_tracing_rate_bar; no cross-wave comparison — interleaved arms).

column1: CONSUMER-COST
column4: Consumer-facing costs vs the original on the same cells: trace bytes, header/template count+bytes, decoder peak RSS, spill volume, close wall. Out-of-family (vs the original or vs sibling cells) = FAIL pending maintainer adjudication.

column1: SCREEN
column4: private-paper name screen over the full unpushed range (the pattern list lives outside the tree), zero matches

column1: TRAILERS
column4: Every commit in the push range carries the mandated trailer form; tree-identity proof recorded for any rewrite.

column1: FEATURE-PARITY
column4: The feature-parity inventory (feature_parity/FEATURE_PARITY.md) reads zero ABSENT and zero unadjudicated PRESENT-DIVERGENT rows against the original's full surface — options, modes, env tunables, counters, documented behaviors (maintainer ruling 2026-10-16: "No features should have been dropped"; row added under that ruling — strictness additions implement rulings, removals remain maintainer-only).
